data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Cloud Firestore noSQL database with live synchronization.
data.what_it_does: Provides a client for Cloud Firestore, allowing apps to store, query, and synchronize data in real time with offline support on Android, iOS, web, Windows, and macOS.
use_when: You need a cloud-hosted NoSQL database for your Flutter app.
Your application requires real-time data synchronization across clients.
You need offline data persistence and access.
avoid_when: You require a relational database with complex SQL joins.
You are using a non-Firebase backend provider.
strengths: Live synchronization out of the box
Built-in offline support for mobile platforms
Deep integration with the Firebase ecosystem
weaknesses: Complex querying limitations typical of NoSQL document databases
data.setup_notes: Requires initializing Firebase via firebase_core and configuring Android/iOS native Firebase project settings.

alternatives.name: supabase
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose if you prefer an open-source Postgres relational database and backend-as-a-service alternative to Firebase.
